title: Placement – core brand
slide_intent: Make institutional marks easy to find across a series by teaching a small set of repeatable positions.
strategic_value: Sheffield Museums can vary layouts across formats while retaining a predictable place for its signature within recurring materials.
demonstration: Gray fields compare a centered seal with six placements at the top or bottom of left, right and center positions.
practical_value: Choose an allowed anchor and reuse its scale and position across a recurring print format.

content_islands.name: Placement guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the section label, title and instructions at left. Keep the note about recurring formats with the placement rule.
